blocks.text: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has summoned a TV host over a viral video that allegedly showed several traffic violations, including not wearing a seatbelt while driving and getting out of the vehicle while in the middle of the road. In a statement on Tuesday, Sept. 22, the LTO said it issued a show cause order (SCO) against the registered owner and driver of an SUV after the agency received a viral video showing people recording themselves singing inside a moving vehicle.
